questions.stem: The pattern 3, 7, 11, 15, … keeps going. What is the 10th number in the pattern?
questions.explanation: Each number is 4 more than the one before. From the 1st to the 10th number there are 9 jumps of 4: 3 + 9 × 4 = 39.

questions.stem: Which number is a multiple of both 4 and 6?
questions.explanation: 36 = 4 × 9 and 36 = 6 × 6. The others: 18 and 30 and 42 are not multiples of 4; 20 is not a multiple of 6.

questions.skill: Division: what to do with the remainder
questions.stem: 50 students are going to a museum. Each car can take 4 students. How many cars are needed so that every student has a seat?
questions.explanation: 50 ÷ 4 = 12 remainder 2. Twelve cars carry 48 students, and the other 2 still need a car, so 13 cars.

questions.explanation: Net B is a cross shape with one square moved along: when folded, every face covers a different side. A, C and E have squares that would overlap (in C, two rows of three leave gaps and overlaps; in A and E, two squares land on the same side). D has five squares in a row, which is too long to wrap around a cube.

distractors.A: two squares would fold onto the same side
distractors.C: two rows of three squares can't fold into a cube
distractors.D: five in a row is too long
distractors.E: two squares would fold onto the same side

questions.stem: Five squares, each with sides of 2 cm, are joined to make this shape. What is the perimeter of the shape?
questions.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 200 160' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' style='max-width:180px' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='14' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><rect x='30.0' y='59.0' width='44.0' height='44.0' fill='currentColor' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke-width='2' /><rect x='74.0' y='103.0' width='44.0' height='44.0' fill='currentColor' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke-width='2' /><rect x='118.0' y='59.0' width='44.0' height='44.0' fill='currentColor' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke-width='2' /><rect x='74.0' y='15.0' width='44.0' height='44.0' fill='currentColor' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke-width='2' /><rect x='74.0' y='59.0' width='44.0' height='44.0' fill='currentColor' fill-opacity='0.2' stroke-width='2' /><text x='96.0' y='10.0' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' font-weight='normal' fill='currentColor' stroke='none' >2 cm</text><line x1='74.0' y1='15.0' x2='118.0' y2='15.0' stroke-width='0' /></svg>
questions.explanation: Count the outside edges: 12 edges, each 2 cm long. 12 × 2 = 24 cm. (Edges where two squares touch are inside the shape and don't count.)

distractors.A: counted edges but forgot each is 2 cm
distractors.B: counted all 4 sides of all 5 squares (5 × 4 × 2)
distractors.C: that is the area in cm²

questions.stem: A school excursion left at 9:40 am and returned at 2:15 pm. How long was the excursion?
questions.explanation: 9:40 am → 10:00 am is 20 minutes. 10:00 am → 2:00 pm is 4 hours. 2:00 → 2:15 is 15 minutes. Total: 4 hours 35 minutes.

distractors.D: subtracted 2 from 9 without thinking about am/pm
distractors.E: subtracted the times like ordinary numbers
